tools.name: access_check_url
tools.description:
Says whether an AI agent may fetch a URL, on what terms, and at what price.
Reads robots.txt for a generic agent and for every AI user-agent the operators document,
the Content-signal and Content-Usage directives, any RSL licence the origin links, and
the live response to an honestly-identified requ

tools.name: access_explain_verdicts
tools.description: Returns the five verdicts access_check_url can give, what each one means for an agent that has just been refused, and the next move for each, plus what each confidence level rests on. Free, makes no network request, and returns the same answer every time: it is the key to reading access_check_url re

tools.name: access_list_agents
tools.description: Returns the AI crawler tokens this index reads robots.txt rules for — only tokens their operators document — plus the widely-written tokens that no operator sends, which make a robots rule unenforceable, and the list of verdict names. Useful when writing or auditing a robots.txt.
